race.title: Bet At Your Best With Betfair Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: KYKOROCK readily brushed aside a couple of subsequent winners when making it 4 wins from 5 starts over fences on his return at Worcester, so there's every chance he can defy another rise. Tigers Moon and We're Red And Blue both offered plenty to work on when starting out in this sphere recently and look the main threats. KYKOROCK (FR) TIGERS MOON WE'RE RED AND BLUE
race.bettingForecast: Kykorock (6/4), We're Red And Blue (9/4), Milan Tino (5/1), Tigers Moon (8/1), Sir Tivo (16/1), Bleu D'enfer (16/1), Calgary Tiger (25/1)
